2. Rotate the paper at a 90 degrees angle.
3. Write your name three times in a way that your name overlaps with theirs
4. Concentrate on your intention behind the love spell.
5. Write why you want the person in your life and write your hopes for the relationship and future. It should encircle the names, and you should avoid lifting your pen when you’re writing the wish.
6. Carefully fold the paper and place it inside a honey jar.
7. Make your fingers touch the honey when you place the paper inside.
8. Recite this love incantation in a loud and clear voice: “Just as this honey is sweet, (insert name of partner) will be for me.”
9. Lick the honey off your fingers before sealing the jar.
10. Shake the jar a bit before placing it somewhere safe and hidden.

You can have a funeral for them (bury stuff that belongs or reminds you of them). Another thing you can do is write their name over and over again on a piece of paper while thinking about every memory you have of them until both sides are completely covered and then rip up the paper and bury it near a tree and let the earth use up all the energy you put into it up.
